targets.outcome_quote: Overall, though this study did not perfectly replicate the findings from Xu and Burleson (2001), we would argue that the evidence from this study indicates general support for Xu and Burleson’s(2001) original findings.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The final explicit Overall verdict states general support for the original findings. Under rule 1 this overall author verdict takes precedence over earlier partial-replication statements and individual differences.
